_transcription: Table 4 (p. 9, 'Hapke parameters found from the SRC disk-integrated analysis'), row H2012-1THG (Hapke 2012 with porosity, single-term Henyey-Greenstein; B_sh,0 = 2.14, h_sh = 0.065 and roughness 19.4 deg fixed from the disk-resolved analysis). The SRC is a panchromatic channel; the authors derived its absolute calibration themselves (Sec. 3, with a synthetic filter; I/F factor (1.73 +- 0.13) x 10^7 DN/s, Eq. 13). No per-colour geometric albedos are tabulated.
